_about: M1-ART-02 post-import rules for the base bodies (game/core/import/base_body_post_import.gd, AssetImportRules). The bodies are PLACEHOLDER art (glTF extras hymn_tag), so the import tags them; they keep their flat glTF PLACEHOLDER_* materials on purpose (no slot_dir), LODs are Godot's auto LODs, and characters have no static collision.
